text: Next came the missing bridge, how much galaxy handedness appears per unit of leftover cosmic spin. Combining tidal torque growth, turnaround, halo spin statistics, and a coherent rotational push gives a transfer coefficient of about 7.2, with an honest bracket from 1.4 to 12.8. Machine algebra reproduced the coefficient and its bounds. Our local novelty check found no printed analytic transfer function of this kind. The strict model still awaits external theorist review before any publication claim.
